no_documents_hint: Press the scan button to get started
take_photo_hint: Take a photo of the document
choose_language_subtitle: Select your preferred language to continue
auth_subtitle: Sign in securely with your Google account.
auth_terms_prefix: I have read and agree to the
auth_terms_required_hint: The Google button is enabled once you tick the Terms & Privacy checkbox above.
settings_language_hint: The entire interface switches to the selected language.
settings_save_location_hint: New PDFs are saved here; the home list reads from this folder.
settings_invalid_folder: That folder is missing or could not be opened.
profile_guest_hint: Sign in to sync features when available.
profile_logout_confirm_body: Sign out and clear login data on this device?
translit_unsupported: Only PDF and .docx files are supported
translit_pdf_warn: PDF formatting won't be preserved (text is recreated)
translit_file_empty_hint1: Select a PDF or Word file
pdf_to_word_info: Each page is converted to an image and text is extracted via OCR
ocr_hint: Select an image — text will be recognized automatically
passport_position_hint: Place the passport within the frame
id_card_position_hint: Place the ID card within the frame
sub_store_unavailable: Store is not available on this device
sub_products_not_found: Plans are not set up in Google Play yet — purchasing will be available soon.
ai_login_body: Sign in with Google to use AI features (translation, Cyrillic and handwriting recognition, auto-naming). It is free.
ai_err_unavailable: AI is temporarily unavailable. Please try later.
ai_err_busy: AI is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
ai_err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ai_named: Named by AI — feel free to change it
profile_delete_account_subtitle: Your account and server data will be permanently deleted
profile_delete_confirm_body: Your account and all your server data will be permanently deleted. Documents on your phone stay. Cancel a Pro subscription separately in Google Play.
profile_delete_relogin: For security, sign in again and tap "Delete account" once more.
pick_from_device_hint: From Telegram, Downloads and other folders
no_app_to_open: No app found to open this file. Send it via "Share".
compress_not_smaller_body: The compressed copy was not smaller, so it was not saved. Keep using the original file.
translate_same_language: Both languages are the same — choose another
translate_nothing: No text to translate was found
edit_add_images_hint: Choose several — each becomes a new page
edit_add_pdf_hint: All its pages are added at the end
translit_mismatch_latin: This file looks like Latin script. Switch the direction to convert it to Cyrillic.
translit_mismatch_cyrillic: This file looks like Cyrillic script. Switch the direction to convert it to Latin.
clean_empty_title: Turn a skewed, shadowy or stained document into a scanner-quality page
clean_empty_hint: Page edges are detected, skew is corrected, shadows and stains are removed. Everything runs on the phone — no internet needed.
sub_feat_offline: Scanner, PDF tools, converter and cleanup — unlimited
sub_feat_free_ai: AI features (translation, text recognition) — limited daily
sub_login_to_see: Sign in with Google to subscribe and use AI.
sub_login_to_link: Purchase received. Sign in and tap "Restore purchases" to link it to your account.
sub_terms_note: Billed through Google Play. Renews automatically; cancel anytime in Google Play.
ai_free_over_title: Today's free limit is used up
ai_free_over_body: Today's free AI limit is used up. Come back tomorrow, or switch to the monthly plan for no ads and more AI. Offline features stay free.
ai_file_big_body: On the free plan this file is too large for AI. You can process it with the monthly plan.
ai_plan_over_body: This month's AI limit is used up. It resets on {date}.
ai_plan_short_body: Your monthly AI limit isn't enough for this file. It resets on {date}.
sub_status_free: You are on the free plan. Go monthly for no ads and more AI.
home_smart_desc: Auto-detects edges, removes shadows and glare, and straightens pages
merge_hint: Choose two or more PDFs. Hold and drag to reorder — page quality stays the same.
split_hint: Split a PDF into separate files — page by page or by the ranges you choose.
split_each_info: {count} separate PDF files will be created.
split_ranges_help: Each range becomes a separate file
split_bad_range: Invalid range. Pages go from 1 to {max}.
lock_hint: A password will be required to open the PDF. The document is encrypted with AES-256.
unlock_hint: Enter the password once — the saved copy opens without a password.
lock_too_short: Password must be at least 4 characters
watermark_hint: A diagonal, semi-transparent text is added to every page — for example "COPY" or a company name.
page_numbers_hint: Adds a number to every page — in the chosen corner, as "3" or "3 / 10".
sign_hint: Draw your signature with a finger, drag it to the right spot on the page and adjust its size.
sign_place_hint: Drag the signature; resize it with the corner handle
qr_hint: Point the frame at a QR code or barcode
qr_not_found: No code found in the image
timestamp_hint: Adds the date and time the photo was taken — for reports, evidence or on-site photos.
timestamp_source_note: The time comes from the photo's data (EXIF), or the file date if missing. Photos are saved to the gallery.
book_hint: Photograph an open book — each photo is split into two pages and combined into one PDF.
solver_hint: Take a photo of a problem — AI solves it step by step
formula_hint: Photograph a formula — AI turns it into text for Word and LaTeX
excel_hint: Photograph a table — AI turns it into an editable Excel file
ppt_hint: Each PDF page becomes a separate slide
formula_word_hint: In Word: Insert → Equation → LaTeX, then paste
explain_hint: Photograph a contract, letter or official paper — AI explains it in plain language
deadlines_hint: Photograph a document — AI finds payment and other deadlines and helps you add them to your calendar
deadlines_none: No deadlines or dates found in this document
deadlines_no_calendar: No calendar app found on this phone
conv_pick_hint: JPG, PNG, WebP images or a PDF
conv_src_images_hint: JPG, PNG, WebP — you can pick several
conv_target_pdf_hint: All images are combined into one PDF
conv_target_jpg_hint: Each image or page becomes a separate JPG
conv_target_long_hint: All pages stacked in one image — handy for messengers
